entries.title: Probiotics and the gut
entries.content: Probiotics may help some people's digestion, for example after antibiotics, but effects depend on the strain. Ask a doctor or pharmacist before starting one.
entries.label: Evidence summary - education only

entries.title: Who should be careful
entries.content: NCCIH and FDA warn probiotics can cause serious infections in premature infants and people with weak immune systems. Check with a doctor first.
entries.label: Evidence summary - education only

entries.title: Mouth to gut
entries.content: Stomach acid kills many swallowed mouth bacteria. Good oral care supports the whole digestive tract.
entries.label: Evidence summary - education only

entries.title: Fiber and gut variety
entries.content: Diets high in refined carbs are linked with less variety in gut microbes. Fiber-rich whole foods support a diverse gut.
entries.source: Oral microbiology - Wikipedia; MedlinePlus healthy eating
entries.label: Evidence summary - education only
